candidates.change_summary: Remove the overflow check require statement so that Deposit always updates balances without checking for overflow.
Delete the balance increment line so Deposit only logs but never updates balances.
Replace balance increment with an assignment (overwrite instead of add), causing balance to be set to msg.value instead of added.
Delete the require/revert guard, so MinSum can be set multiple times.
Change assignment to MinSum = 0, so its value never reflects the argument.
Change assignment to MinSum = _val + 1, so stored value differs predictably.
Insert `MinSum = 0;` after the existing assignment, overwriting MinSum.
